explanations.cto: Average cost (PMP) {{pmp, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} × {{quantity}} = {{cost, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} acquisition cost. Proceeds {{proceeds, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}, fees {{fees, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}. Net {{net, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}.
explanations.crypto: Art. 150 VH bis: cession {{cession, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} − (total acquisition price {{totalCost, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} × {{cession, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} / portfolio value {{portfolioValue, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}) − fees {{fees, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} = {{net, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}.
explanations.dividend: Gross dividend {{amount, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}. Tax withheld abroad: {{withholding, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}. 40 % allowance if you opt for the progressive scale.
explanations.peaBefore5: Plan {{age}} year(s) old: withdrawal {{amount, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} − (net deposits {{deposits, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} × {{amount, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} / plan value {{planValue, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}) = gain {{net, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}. Before 5 years the plan is closed; the gain bears {{incomeTaxRate, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} % income tax and {{socialRate, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} % social contributions.
explanations.peaAfter5: Plan {{age}} year(s) old: withdrawal {{amount, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} − (net deposits {{deposits, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} × {{amount, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}} / plan value {{planValue, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}) = gain {{net, number(minimumFractionDigits: 2; maximumFractionDigits: 2)}}. After 5 years: no income tax, {{socialRate, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} % social contributions.

cto.rule1: Flat Tax (PFU {{rate}}%: {{ir}}% income tax + {{social}}% social contributions) or optional progressive income tax scale
cto.rulesNotice: Rules applied for fiscal year {{year}}. This guide is informational and is not tax advice: check impots.gouv.fr or a tax professional before filing.
cto.rateExceptions: Rate exceptions: income from life insurance and capitalisation contracts (except rente-survie and épargne-handicap contracts), interest on CEL and PEL accounts opened up to 31 December 2017 (first 12 years for PEL) and income-tax-exempt PEP income stay at 17.2% social contributions. Dividends and interest paid and withheld in 2025 stayed at 17.2%. Source: impots.gouv.fr, 2026.
cto.rule2: Cost basis calculated using Weighted Average Price (PMP)
cto.rule3: Capital losses can offset capital gains of the same nature, carried forward for 10 years
cto.rule4: Form 2074 for detailed sales reporting, Form 2042 boxes 3VG / 3VH

pea.rule1: Internal dividends and capital gains are not taxable
pea.rule2: After 5 years: partial withdrawals without account closure, only social charges apply

crypto.rule2: Sales to fiat currency (€, $) or real-world goods: taxable at {{rate}}%
crypto.rule3: Capital losses cannot be carried forward to future years (unlike CTO)

settings.title: Fiscal Profile
settings.subtitle: These details are used to compute personalized tax estimates. They are stored locally and never shared.
settings.taxResidenceInfo: Country where you are tax-resident. Currently only France is supported.
settings.departmentInfo: Automatically determines your online declaration deadline across the 3 French tax zones.
settings.familyStatusInfo: Your marital/family situation for the current fiscal year.
settings.fiscalSharesInfo: Number of fiscal shares in your household (e.g., 1 for single, 2 for couple, 2.5 with one child).
settings.otherIncomeInfo: Your total taxable income EXCLUDING capital gains and dividends. Used for PFU vs Barème comparison.
settings.estimatedTMIInfo: Your marginal tax rate bracket. Auto-calculated if other income and fiscal shares are provided.
settings.hasOpted2OPInfo: Check if you have already chosen the progressive tax scale for all your capital income.
settings.lossCarryforwardsInfo: Capital losses from previous years that can offset future gains (10-year limit).
